summary: Starts project and file totals earlier on workspace reload and reduces duplicate database reads during permission loading.
userImpact: Project and file totals can appear sooner while the rest of the dashboard loads.
security: Permission lookups are reused within the same authenticated request. Dashboard reads still require a verified organization session and permission.
documentation: The dashboard uses the existing tenant-scoped project statistics endpoint.
rollback: Redeploy the previous compatible application images.
validation: Permission snapshot and browser tests cover request-local lookup reuse and progressive dashboard loading.

customerDocumentation.reason: The existing dashboard controls and workflow are unchanged.
